⭐ Thank you downloading my character template pack! I hope these sprites help you start your project, practice pixel art, or customize characters easier.
⭐ Please note that the 16x16 sprites use a 24x24 canvas, and the 16x32 sprites use a 32x32 canvas to allow extra room for animation.

License:
​❌ Using the templates for character commissions, asset packs, ect, is not allowed! You cannot resell the template with addons, or modifications.
If the product is free, you MUST credit, and link to the original template: Original character template created by Eris Esra: https://erisesra.itch.io/character-templates-pack​​​

​​​​✅ ​Using the templates for commercial and non-commercial projects. For example, putting them in games, is allowed! Credit is appreciated, but not required!

​The purpose of making these templates was to help people dip their toes into making games, and creating pixelart characters, all for free! By trying to repackage, and sell them, that strictly goes again their purpose! They're meant to be a stepping stone, not the stone itself!

If you end up using them, feel free to tag me!
https://www.erisesra.com/socials

⭐ I wish you the best of luck in your projects!
